canonical_statement: The EMPA-REG METSU study evaluated the efficacy, safety, and tolerability of empagliflozin 10 mg and 25 mg versus placebo over 24 weeks as add-on therapy to metformin plus sulfonylurea in adults with type 2 diabetes and inadequate glycemic control.

population.label: Randomized adults with type 2 diabetes inadequately controlled on metformin plus sulfonylurea

canonical_statement: This was a randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blind phase III trial conducted from July 2010 to February 2012 at 148 centers in 12 countries.

population.label: Randomized adults with type 2 diabetes inadequately controlled on metformin plus sulfonylurea

canonical_statement: The trial was registered as NCT01159600, received relevant ethics approvals, complied with the Declaration of Helsinki and Good Clinical Practice, and required written informed consent.

population.label: Randomized adults with type 2 diabetes inadequately controlled on metformin plus sulfonylurea

canonical_statement: Eligible randomized participants were adults aged at least 18 years with BMI no greater than 45 kg/m² and HbA1c 7.0–10.0% despite diet, exercise, and stable metformin plus sulfonylurea therapy.

population.label: Eligible randomized adults with type 2 diabetes
inclusion_criteria: Stable metformin plus sulfonylurea for ≥12 weeks

canonical_statement: Background metformin had to be at least 1,500 mg/day, the maximum tolerated dose, or the local-label maximum; sulfonylurea had to be at least half the maximum recommended dose, the maximum tolerated dose, or the local-label maximum.

inclusion_criteria: Metformin ≥1,500 mg/day or maximum tolerated/local-label dose
Sulfonylurea ≥half maximum recommended or maximum tolerated/local-label dose

canonical_statement: Key exclusions included confirmed fasting glucose above 13.3 mmol/L, acute coronary syndrome/stroke/TIA within 3 months, liver disease, eGFR below 30 mL/min/1.73 m², contraindications to metformin or sulfonylurea, and several conditions or treatments expected to confound safety or weight.

canonical_statement: After a 2-week placebo run-in, participants were randomized 1:1:1 to empagliflozin 10 mg once daily, empagliflozin 25 mg once daily, or placebo for 24 weeks, each added to metformin plus sulfonylurea.

canonical_statement: The study was funded by Boehringer Ingelheim.

Several authors were employees of Boehringer Ingelheim; other authors reported advisory, investigator, consultant, or speaker relationships with pharmaceutical companies, and medical writing assistance was financially supported by Boehringer Ingelheim.

The authors concluded that empagliflozin 10 mg and 25 mg added to metformin plus sulfonylurea produced clinically meaningful improvements in glycemic control, reduced body weight and systolic blood pressure, and was well tolerated over 24 weeks.
